claim: On breast_cancer (114 held-out rows, majority 0.6316), local_goodness with its declared target channel (credit.readout_error=True) and gradient are equivalent within a +/-0.01 val_acc margin at L2/20 on the same digital/feedforward/instantaneous/null/adam cell, paired over seeds 57-61
protocol: TODO92 section 0 standing stop-loss. The breadth exit is green (experiments/t92_breadth_second_family.duckdb, run a12ff0bd), and the stop-loss asks whether any non-standard composition matches the standard stack at matched cost on >=2 task families with a declared domain bar. local_goodness is the only non-standard credit with claim-grade parity so far, and it holds only vision (MNIST, section 3.11 follow-up). This run supplies the tabular family: wine is at ceiling (both arms 1.0000) and cannot discriminate, so breast_cancer (declared bar 0.6316, 114 held out, resolution 0.88 pp) is the tabular coordinate. Control = credit gradient; treatment = credit local_goodness + credit.readout_error=True; both arms use the breadth probe's reference stack (digital/feedforward/instantaneous/null/adam, geometry.hidden_dim=256), L2/20, seeds 57-61, CPU; only the credit, its declared channel and the seed differ. Pilot (1 epoch, seed 57, CPU, not a registered seed) is printed by the probe before the run. Decision: the 95% bootstrap CI of the paired treatment-minus-control difference lies inside [-0.01, +0.01] (computronium.validation.preregistration.PairedComparison.passes_equivalence). Error costs: a false EQUIVALENT keeps a parity credit alive on a second family and licenses one more map row; a false NOT-EQUIVALENT retires a credit that may hold parity, which the plan answers by re-running the same cell, never by tuning. Stop rule: if the CI leaves the margin, report the measured boundary and do not tune lr, do not add seeds, do not add a third task; the stop-loss disposition is then written from the map.
